Steep, Scary Stairs !
Feb 2026 • Couples
We had reservations and were eager to have dinner at Le Corto. We were out sightseeing and wanted to see just where it was and if we could safely walk there from the Park Hyatt. We found it, it was very close. We walked in to see the restaurant. 

A very nice young man took us up a very long steep flight of stairs to see the dining room. I was surprised as no one at the hotel who made our reservations or anyone on TripAdvisor made any mention of this. I asked the young man about the dining room downstairs and he said they do not serve dinner there. We are in seniors in good shape, but like to have a cocktail and or wine with our dinner. I was willing to give it a go, but it did give me pause and I wondered what someone with mobility issues would do. There is no elevator we were told. 

Turns out my husband became ill that afternoon so we had to cancel. They were very nice and accommodating with the cancellation but I still wonder about those scary stairs. There is no way a person with any kind of walking issues could navigate them.

A culinary pearl in the heart of Saigon.
Apr 2026 • Couples
Wonderful experience at this amazing location, everything about this restaurant is incredible,the service, the atmosphere and most importantly the food! The preparation and presentation of every dish was amazing, I always appreciate the details and in this restaurant they are definitely detail oriented. 
For starters we had the escargot which were perfect and oozing with rich butter and garlic, they were accompanied by slices of garlic bread. 
For our mains we went with the duck breast cooked to perfection and with the best New Zealand lamb chops I’ve had in a long while. Both dishes were accompanied by veggies and wonderful sauces. 
Finally, we were treated to their complimentary dessert which is just delicious. 
Our meal was accompanied by the sounds of a marvelous saxophonist with made our evening that much more unforgettable. 
This was our last dinner in HCMC and we certainly enjoyed what has been a great trip to this beautiful land.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ A Culinary Highlight of Our Trip – Truly World-Class, We look forward to repeating.
Dec 2025 • Family
We visited Le Corto last week as a family—mom, dad, and son—traveling from abroad, and it was without question one of the most memorable dining experiences of our entire trip.

From the very first bite, we knew we were in for something special. The French Snail (Ốc Pháp), baked in fragrant parsley and garlic butter, was rich, comforting, and perfectly balanced. The Homemade Pâté en Croûte, served with young lettuce salad, onion marmalade, and condiments, was beautifully crafted—classic French technique done flawlessly. The salmon platter was fresh, elegant, and ideal for sharing.

For the main courses, every dish impressed us. The Long An Barbary Duck was outstanding—seven days dry-aged, expertly roasted duck breast, paired with young carrots and a vibrant orange sauce. The Beef Wellington was cooked to perfection, tender and flavorful, complemented by truffle mashed potatoes, asparagus, and a luxurious Périgourdine sauce. The Pan-Fried Seabass was equally impressive—delicate, fresh, and beautifully presented.

Dessert was a true spectacle and a joy for our son to watch. The Crêpes Suzette Flambé, cooked over high fire right in front of us, was both theatrical and delicious, while the Crème Brûlée had the perfect crackling top and silky smooth custard. We paired our meal with Château Le Grand Verdus Bordeaux Blanc, which elevated the entire experience.

What truly made (Our ALL YOU CAN EAT) exceptional was the service. The crew was attentive, warm, and professional, making us feel genuinely welcome. Special thanks to Lyn and Troung, whose hospitality, knowledge, and care turned a wonderful lunch into an unforgettable family memory.

Le Corto is not just a restaurant—it’s an experience. For travelers looking for refined French cuisine, impeccable service, and an atmosphere that feels both elegant and welcoming, this place is a must-visit. We sincerely hope to return on our next trip.
